customChangeSurface.description: DS Harness name, bundle identifier, Custom flavor, startup branding, and isolation from the official Desktop.
customChangeSurface.upstreamDependency: Electron product configuration, userData resolution, single-instance ownership, and startup renderer contracts.
customChangeSurface.riskSignificance: A regression can rename the product, reuse the official profile/userData boundary, or show stale official branding.

customChangeSurface.description: Custom package/install entry points, runtime tree, Electron builder inputs, and package-set closure.
customChangeSurface.upstreamDependency: Desktop staging layout, runtime descriptor, packaged Node Host, package resolution, and release-family build contracts.
customChangeSurface.riskSignificance: Changes can produce an incomplete runtime, wrong architecture, missing native module, or non-replayable product build.

customChangeSurface.description: The built-in Cordis bundle that composes the approved Phase 2–7 capabilities.
customChangeSurface.upstreamDependency: Cordis patch schema, base/web bundles, package export resolution, and Desktop package-set loading.
customChangeSurface.riskSignificance: Composition drift can silently omit a capability or make the Custom runtime fail during startup.

customChangeSurface.description: Run State, backend observation, run control, Task Checkpoint, reasoning, compaction, and diagnostics capabilities.
customChangeSurface.upstreamDependency: Agent events, LLM streaming/retry hooks, Session events/projections, compaction executor, and token-meter contracts.
customChangeSurface.riskSignificance: Interface drift can break observability or safety invariants while leaving the Desktop superficially runnable.

customChangeSurface.description: desktop-custom profile, Electron userData isolation, bundled Node Host, and intentionally shared settings/session boundaries.
customChangeSurface.upstreamDependency: Profile link/loading, project/runtime descriptors, userData, settings, sessions, and migration semantics.
customChangeSurface.riskSignificance: This is a data-safety boundary; a mismatch can mix official and Custom runtime state or migrate shared data unexpectedly.

customChangeSurface.description: Run Details diagnostics surface, idle-state closure, startup shell, title, and client composition wiring.
customChangeSurface.upstreamDependency: Client remote transport, renderer slots, conversation layout, startup URL, and title/branding contracts.
customChangeSurface.riskSignificance: Changes can hide diagnostics, reintroduce an idle dock gap, or surface official branding.

customChangeSurface.description: Phase 2–8A contract, packaging, composition, UI, and safety regression coverage.
customChangeSurface.upstreamDependency: Vitest, test helpers, Desktop fixtures, and package build conventions.
customChangeSurface.riskSignificance: Test-framework drift can hide or falsely report compatibility failures; it does not itself prove a product regression.

customChangeSurface.description: Bilingual architecture records, subsystem documentation, generated catalogs, and baseline attestations.
customChangeSurface.upstreamDependency: Documentation pairing, generated-catalog, link, and architecture-note conventions.
customChangeSurface.riskSignificance: Documentation drift is normally non-runtime but can invalidate generated-doc gates and maintenance evidence.

customChangeSurface.description: Workspace references, dependency lock, package metadata, build faces, exports, and release families required by Custom packages.
customChangeSurface.upstreamDependency: Workspace discovery, TypeScript project references, package exports, build/release tooling, and dependency resolution.
customChangeSurface.riskSignificance: Structural drift can make Custom packages disappear from builds or resolve incompatible runtime dependencies.

seams.description: Product name, bundle identity, startup branding, userData, and single-instance isolation for DS Harness.
seams.interface: Electron productName/appId, app.setPath('userData'), single-instance ownership, startup URL/title, and flavor selection.
seams.whyItMatters: A mismatch can collapse Custom and official state boundaries or regress visible DS Harness identity.
seams.failureMode: Wrong app name or bundle id, shared userData/profile, stale official startup branding, or competing instance ownership.
seams.detectionMethod: Exact path and rename detection; product/data-safety contract paths are treated as structural signals.

seams.description: Desktop staging, Electron packaging, runtime descriptor, and Custom install artifact contract.
seams.interface: Prepared Resources/dsh tree, packaged Node executable, package-set closure, builder configuration, target architecture, and install source.
seams.whyItMatters: The product is replayed from this pipeline and native/runtime closure must match Electron and macOS architecture.
seams.failureMode: Missing Host/runtime package, wrong executable architecture, invalid signing input, or incomplete Custom artifact.
seams.detectionMethod: Path/rename detection plus package/build manifest and runtime-tree structural signals.

seams.description: Cordis bundle schema and package-set loading used to inject the Custom capability composition.
seams.interface: Cordis patch declarations, package names/exports, built-in package resolution, and Desktop package-set materialization.
seams.whyItMatters: All Phase 2–7 packages enter the daily product through this deliberately thin composition seam.
seams.failureMode: Startup load error, unresolved package, invalid patch schema, or silently absent diagnostics/policy capability.
seams.detectionMethod: Bundle/package/loader path detection, manifest changes, and rename tracking.

seams.description: Client package export faces, remote client registration, slot ownership, and renderer package loading.
seams.interface: Client/remote export maps, package manifest loading, UI slots, connection commands, and renderer registration.
seams.whyItMatters: Run Details is a client plugin and depends on upstream loader and layout contracts without owning them.
seams.failureMode: Client bundle build failure, missing remote, unrendered dock, duplicate slot owner, or runtime module resolution failure.
seams.detectionMethod: Contract-path and package-export changes; exact rename detection for client contracts.

seams.description: Custom profile selection and the intentional isolation/sharing boundary for userData, settings, and Sessions.
seams.interface: Profile path/name, profile-link resolution, settings ownership, Session persistence location/schema, and userData derivation.
seams.whyItMatters: The official and Custom products are isolated in some stores and intentionally share others; accidental drift is a data-safety issue.
seams.failureMode: Wrong profile, duplicate or migrated settings, conflicting concurrent Session writers, or data written under a new path.
seams.detectionMethod: Exact data-boundary paths, schema/type files, migrations, and renames always require manual review.

seams.description: Agent lifecycle, request-attempt, stream, retry, cancellation, and tool event surfaces projected by Run State and policy.
seams.interface: Run/Attempt correlation, agent event payloads, model-attempt lifecycle, tool completion facts, retry gates, and cancellation acknowledgement.
seams.whyItMatters: Run State and recovery safety project existing events; they must not guess if lifecycle semantics change.
seams.failureMode: Wrong Run attribution, terminal-state overwrite, unsafe retry, lost cancellation acknowledgement, or TOOL_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN bypass.
seams.detectionMethod: Agent/core contract paths, event schema/type changes, direct overlap, and rename detection.

seams.description: LLM request, reasoning effort, streaming chunks, retry classification, token usage, and provider adapter contracts.
seams.interface: Request-level reasoning, stream chunks, usage/cache accounting, retry/error payloads, and provider defaults.
seams.whyItMatters: The IQ3_S policy and Run projection depend on explicit wire values and observed stream facts, not inferred configuration.
seams.failureMode: Unsupported reasoning sent on wire, lost activity, false retry classification, or inaccurate context pressure.
seams.detectionMethod: Type/adapter contract paths and package export changes; adjacent implementation is medium risk pending review.

seams.description: Session event durability, known event registration, projection replay, and persistence format used by Run and Task state.
seams.interface: Durable Session event envelope, known-type catalog, JSONL format, projection registration/replay, and atomic persistence.
seams.whyItMatters: Run terminal facts, Task Checkpoint, and Result Manifest survive restart only through these upstream contracts.
seams.failureMode: Events rejected, projections not rebuilt, checkpoint loss, schema incompatibility, or unsafe resume eligibility.
seams.detectionMethod: Schema/type/event/persistence paths and migrations; direct overlap is explicitly recorded.

seams.description: Compaction executor, surface replacement, token meter, tool-result governance, and auxiliary reasoning isolation.
seams.interface: Pressure facts, compaction eligibility/execution, candidate validation, atomic surface apply, and tool-output references.
seams.whyItMatters: Main-task xhigh reasoning and checkpoint authority rely on compaction staying auxiliary, validated, and fail-closed.
seams.failureMode: Main reasoning polluted, facts dropped, old surface deleted before validation, or compaction used as recovery.
seams.detectionMethod: Compaction/token surface paths, schema/type changes, and direct overlap detection.

seams.description: Read-only diagnostics transport and UI source contract from Run State to Run Details.
seams.interface: Typert/remote service publication, client snapshot source, UI slot ownership, and explicit Unknown/idle presentation.
seams.whyItMatters: Diagnostics must remain read-only and must not fabricate health when backend facts are absent.
seams.failureMode: Transport break, missing panel, stale snapshot, idle ghost dock, or Unknown coerced to a false healthy state.
seams.detectionMethod: Remote/client contract and slot paths; exact overlaps and renames increase confidence.

seams.description: Electron/Node ABI and packaged native modules required by the Desktop Host.
seams.interface: Electron version, bundled Node version/architecture, native ABI, target platform, and fs-ext/koffi/sharp/node-pty closure.
seams.whyItMatters: The verified product ships native modules and a packaged Host; version drift is invisible until load or spawn time.
seams.failureMode: dlopen/ABI failure, missing native binary, wrong architecture, or packaged Host startup failure.
seams.detectionMethod: Manifest/lock/runtime changes are inspected for Electron, Node, target, and named native dependencies rather than treating every dependency change as high risk.
